Risk Statement: Former employees or volunteers retain active accounts after separation
Existing Preventive Controls: HR-triggered offboarding workflow requiring IT to revoke all access within two hours
Existing Detective Controls: Monthly automated audit comparing terminated HR records with active system accounts

Risk Statement: Current employees or volunteers retain unnecessary elevated access after role changes, enabling unauthorized access to, alteration of, or disclosure of PHI and PII.
Existing Preventive Controls: Role-based baseline access; manager and IT approval, documented business purpose, and automatic expiration for temporary elevated access
Existing Detective Controls: Quarterly role-based access review and automated query identifying nonclinical users with elevated administrator access
KPI: Percentage of accounts reviewed and remediated

Risk Statement: Employees or volunteers may interact with phishing messages that steal credentials, deploy malware, or cause unauthorized disclosure of PHI and PII.
Existing Preventive Controls: Role-specific recurring security awareness training; phishing-resistant MFA; email filtering and attachment scanning
Existing Detective Controls: Quarterly phishing simulations; reporting metrics; review of suspicious-email reports and failed-login alerts
KPI: Phishing reporting rate and simulation failure rate
Target: 100% annual training; improving report rate; declining failure rate

Risk Statement: Third-party vendors with access to patient or organizational systems may have inadequate security controls, leading to unauthorized access, data exposure, or service disruption.
Existing Preventive Controls: Pre-engagement vendor security assessment; signed BAA for PHI-handling vendors; least-privilege MFA-protected access; contractual incident-reporting requirements
Existing Detective Controls: Ongoing monitoring of vendor access logs and security alerts; periodic vendor reassessments
KPI: Percentage of active vendors with current assessment BAA and quarterly access review

Risk Statement: Lost, stolen, or unencrypted laptops, tablets, and mobile phones may expose PHI, PII, credentials, or organizational data to unauthorized individuals.
Existing Preventive Controls: Mandatory full-disk encryption on all organization-issued endpoints; MDM enrollment; strong screen lock or biometric authentication; MFA; automatic screen lock; asset inventory and secure device-custody requirements
Existing Detective Controls: Monthly MDM encryption and enrollment compliance reports; alerts for devices out of MDM compliance; asset-inventory reconciliation; lost or stolen device help-desk tickets; periodic authentication and device-access log reviews
KPI: Percentage of organization-issued endpoints verified as encrypted and enrolled in MDM
